slides.title: DNA Sequences in Biopython
slides.prompt: Biopython provides specialized biological sequence data structures, alignment algorithms, and genomic database integration tools.
slides.codeSnippet:
from Bio.Seq import Seq

my_dna = Seq('AGTACACTGGT')
print(my_dna.complement())
print(my_dna.translate())

slides.title: Sequence Translation (Central Dogma)
slides.prompt: What transformation occurs when calling `.translate()` on an mRNA `Seq` object in Biopython?
options: It converts nucleotide codon triplets into corresponding amino acid protein sequences
It converts DNA into RNA by swapping Thymine for Uracil
It aligns the sequence against the human reference genome
It calculates the molecular weight of the strand
slides.correctAnswer: It converts nucleotide codon triplets into corresponding amino acid protein sequences
